## [Licence-holder matrix]{.en}[许可持有方矩阵]{.zh} {#licence-matrix}

::: {.en}
**Table A1. Victoria's ten WtE licence holders**

::: tw
| Holder | Licence | Site and status | Technology | EPC / O&M | CDEG entry point |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleanaway | Cap 760,000 | Wollert MERC; EPA application to be re-filed; EQT takeover pending | Not announced (open EOI) | Not announced | O&M if not self-operated or bundled; ask the new owner |
| HiQ EFW Victoria | Cap 750,000 | Bulla; full operation about late 2030; no planning approval | Kanadevia Inova | Not announced | O&M if the vendor does not bundle it |
| Melbourne Water | Cap 450,000 | Plant at a treatment site (ETP or WTP) under study; feasibility 2026–31; biosolids tender 2025 | Open | Open | Biosolids and sludge co-firing match CDEG's experience |
| Recovered Energy Laverton | Existing-operator; cap 280,000 | Laverton North; start not confirmed | Vertical rotating gasification | Not announced | Conditional: below CDEG's two-line minimum; gasification |
| Liquid Power Co | Cap 50,000 | Early development | Gasification + Fischer-Tropsch | Not announced | Low: below 250 t/d |
| Zerogen Holdings | Cap 45,000 | Wellington precinct | Plasma-assisted gasification | Not announced | Low: below 250 t/d |
| Knox Transfer Station | Cap 15,000 | To be confirmed | Not announced | Not announced | Low: small |
| Paper Australia (Opal), Maryvale | Existing-operator | Pre-construction; no financial close found; A\$48.2m federal grant | Babcock & Wilcox; EPC Cobra \[94\] | Veolia in consortium | Low: operator in place |
| Visy Industries | Existing-operator | Coolaroo; existing facility | Not checked | Not checked | To research |
| Great Southern Waste Technologies | Existing-operator | Dandenong South, 100,000 t/yr | Norwegian rights | Not announced | Check operator |
:::

*Sources: EPA Victoria licence register and team precedent briefing \[1, 32, 33, 73, 94\]. "Not announced" means no public announcement was found; it does not mean the role is unfilled.*
:::

::: {.zh}
**表A1：维州十家焚烧发电许可持有方**

::: tw
| 持有方 | 许可 | 场址与状态 | 技术 | EPC / 运营 | 集团切入点 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleanaway | 配额76万吨 | Wollert MERC；EPA申请将重新提交；EQT收购待完成 | 未公布（意向征集进行中） | 未公布 | 若不自营或捆绑，则提供运营；向新业主了解 |
| HiQ EFW Victoria | 配额75万吨 | Bulla；约2030年底全面投运；尚无规划批准 | Kanadevia Inova | 未公布 | 若设备商不捆绑，则提供运营 |
| Melbourne Water | 配额45万吨 | 正在研究在污水处理厂（ETP或WTP）建厂；2026–31年可行性研究；2025年生物固体招标 | 未定 | 未定 | 生物固体与污泥掺烧与集团经验吻合 |
| Recovered Energy Laverton | 既有运营商许可；配额28万吨 | Laverton North；开工时间未确认 | 立式旋转气化 | 未公布 | 有条件：低于集团两条线下限；气化技术 |
| Liquid Power Co | 配额5万吨 | 早期开发 | 气化+费托合成 | 未公布 | 低：不足250吨/日 |
| Zerogen Holdings | 配额4.5万吨 | Wellington园区 | 等离子辅助气化 | 未公布 | 低：不足250吨/日 |
| Knox Transfer Station | 配额1.5万吨 | 待确认 | 未公布 | 未公布 | 低：规模小 |
| Paper Australia（Opal），Maryvale | 既有运营商许可 | 施工前阶段；未找到融资关闭信息；4,820万澳元联邦拨款 | Babcock & Wilcox；EPC为Cobra \[94\] | Veolia在联合体内 | 低：已有运营方 |
| Visy Industries | 既有运营商许可 | Coolaroo；现有设施 | 未核查 | 未核查 | 待研究 |
| Great Southern Waste Technologies | 既有运营商许可 | Dandenong South，10万吨/年 | 挪威技术授权 | 未公布 | 核实运营方 |
:::

*来源：EPA维州许可登记册及团队先例简报 \[1, 32, 33, 73, 94\]。“未公布”指未找到公开公告，并不表示该角色空缺。*
:::
